title: A long-term monitoring study of patients suffering from a malignant neoplasm of the central nervous system previously treated with hematopoietic stem cells
official: A follow-up study evaluating the long term safety of autologous CD34+-enriched hematopoietic progenitor cells genetically modified with a lentiviral vector encoding for the human interferon-α2 gene previously administered to patients with glioblastoma multiforme
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to evaluate the long term mutagenic safety of Temferon.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients who have received Temferon and completed the follow-up in the TEM-GBM_001 study.
2. Able and willing to provide written informed consent and comply with the study protocol and procedures.
Exclusion criteria:
1. There are no exclusion criteria for this study
